AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
AUTH_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
USER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Your account has no email address, so it cannot own circuits.
NOT_FOUND: That circuit does not exist, or it is not shared with you.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Something in that request was not valid.
MALFORMED_JSON: The request could not be read.
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The request was sent in a format the server does not accept.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That request is too large to send.
CIRCUIT_TOO_LARGE: This circuit is too large to save.
VERSION_CONFLICT: Another save arrived first. Reload the history and save again.
USER_EMAIL_ALREADY_LINKED: Another account already uses this email address.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
USERNAME_UNAVAILABLE: A username could not be assigned. Try again.
DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server.
NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
RESPONSE_MALFORMED: The server sent an unexpected response. Reload the page.
SESSION_UNAVAILABLE: Your session could not be read. Sign in again.
